python3 -c "
import re

def slugify(text: str, sep: str = '-') -> str:
    pattern = r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]+'
    pieces = [p for p in re.split(pattern, text) if p]
    return sep.join(pieces).lower()

print(repr(slugify('  Hello, World!! ')))
print(repr(slugify('A B', sep='_')))
print(repr(slugify('')))
print(repr(slugify('---')))
print(repr(slugify('foo---bar')))
print(repr(slugify('123 Foo Bar 456')))
print(repr(slugify('CAFÉ')))
"

python3 -c "
import re

def slugify(text: str, sep: str = '-') -> str:
    cleaned = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', sep, text.lower())
    if sep:
        return cleaned.strip(sep)
    return cleaned

print(repr(slugify('  Hello, World!! ')))
print(repr(slugify('A B', sep='_')))
print(repr(slugify('  foo  bar  ', sep='-')))
print(repr(slugify('-foo-bar-', sep='-')))
"
